line: Six document problems, each run end to end on the input in its folder, with the input and every output included, measured and runnable with one command.
about: Six document problems, each run end to end on the input in its folder, with the input and every output included, measured and runnable with one command.

cases.title: My PDF has cut-off pages and is too large to send
cases.problem: My PDF has cut-off pages and is too large to send
cases.result: I restored the cut-off text and reduced this PDF from 28.40 MB to 0.125 MB, retaining all 3 pages and 224 words.

cases.title: My eBook needs a properly laid-out print PDF
cases.problem: My eBook needs a properly laid-out print PDF
cases.result: I laid out a six-chapter manuscript as a checked 26-page print interior, with editable source and before/after proof.

cases.title: Kindle notes won’t open
cases.problem: My Kindle book needs footnotes readers can tap and return from
cases.result: I built a reflowable EPUB 3 with 22 references to 18 notes, no EPUBCheck errors or warnings, and 88 passing browser tap-and-return journeys; tested in a browser, not on a Kindle or the Kindle Previewer.

cases.title: Handwritten notes, typed without guesswork
cases.problem: I need handwritten notes typed clearly without guessing unclear words
cases.result: I turned a transcript I prepared from the page into an editable document, a PDF and a page/block map, with the unclear word left marked as [unclear], not guessed; the tool performs no handwriting recognition.

cases.title: My figures need a presentation
cases.problem: I need a business presentation built from my figures
cases.result: I built an editable PPTX with native charts, a PDF deck and checked source-to-chart reconciliation.

cases.title: School forms that stay in place
cases.problem: I need school forms people can fill in without moving the layout
cases.result: I built trip-permission and absence-request DOCX forms, entered multiline text and checkbox states in LibreOffice, and verified the saved and reopened files.
